archetypes.name: bootstrap-release
archetypes.rationale: Targets the highest-risk RC1 plan path where release-time execution context may diverge from installed-plugin assumptions.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed /release change actually runs the just-released upgrade script in a context where paths, versions, pruning, and marketplace cache locations resolve as intended. Compare the plan against the release skill and upgrade script evidence, looking for wrong roots, stale-version assumptions, missing fallbacks, or operator-visible ambiguity. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sparse-contract
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the new shared sparse allowlist contract is complete and consistently consumed across upgrade, health, docs, and tests.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the plan for contract drift around LARCH_SPARSE_DIRS, normalize_sparse_dirs, sparse-checkout comparisons, and known marketplace state. Verify that each planned consumer can source and use the shared library safely without duplicating or subtly changing normalization semantics. Look for missing edit-in-sync targets, schema/path mismatches, or test coverage gaps for future allowlist additions. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
